recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast macro photograph of dense green botanical foliage serves as a textured background for a multi-layered typographic lockup featuring gold-beveled script and bold serif lettering, accented by a horizontal banner and a wispy smoke trail.
coreVisualRelationships: Textured organic background vs. sharp metallic typography
Horizontal banner bisecting the upper third of the composition
Curvilinear smoke element contrasting with rigid block lettering
Gold and white highlights popping against deep green shadows
coreInvariants: Beveled gold-to-white gradient on primary text
Heavy black drop shadows for legibility

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The botanical background is full-bleed; the typography is centered in the upper half, occupying approximately 40% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, beveled gold script word in the upper center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top script, drops to the bold block text, follows the banner right, and rests on the advisory logo in the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is dense and 'busy' with organic textures filling all non-typographic areas.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep forest green and olive (background texture)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden yellow (primary text fill and banner)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between dark, saturated greens and bright, desaturated metallic text effects.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earthy tones and metallics

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Mix of high-contrast script and heavy slab-serif
letterConstructionRules: Primary script features thick downstrokes and thin connectors
Secondary block text uses heavy, beveled slab serifs with internal gradients
All text features a thick black outer stroke or drop shadow
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are tightly kerned to overlap slightly
Beveling effect creates a 3D metallic appearance
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Script over block serif for a 'street-luxury' contrast.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the fluid, high-contrast script energy
Provides the necessary weight for the slab-serif subtitle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a macro photograph of dense, textured green botanical leaves with high contrast, deep shadows, and bright highlights on the edges of the leaves.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a central typographic lockup. Top line: gold beveled script. Middle line: large white beveled slab-serif caps with heavy black shadows. Bottom line: a gold ribbon banner with dark serif text. Add a thin white smoke swirl above the script and a parental advisory logo in the bottom right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the background purely botanical and textured?
Does the text have a 3D beveled appearance?
Is there a clear hierarchy between the script and the block text?
Is the color palette restricted to greens, golds, and whites?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the gold metallic sheen
postGenerationChecks: Check for beveled edge consistency on all letters
Ensure the smoke trail does not obscure the text legibility
Verify the background is high-resolution macro texture
Confirm the parental advisory box is correctly placed in the corner
recipe.reuseFormula: Macro [botanical texture] + [beveled gold script] + [heavy slab-serif] + [ribbon banner] = Urban Botanical Aesthetic
